consumer search platform: 1B+ indexed pages, 10M+ unique users/month

  • Built pagecraft, an internal developer-productivity CLI adopted across the team — PR review workflow with parallelized GitHub fetches and Nix/darwin tooling.
  • Built MCP integration and AI inference harness on the engineering platform; authored "Jon's Workflow with AI," adopted org-wide as the reference for AI-assisted engineering practice.

  • Sustained high-volume, substantive peer code review across the platform org — 261 reviews in the first 15 weeks of 2026 alone (~75/month, mean 6 / median 4 comments per PR, ~1,000-line PR average) — reinforcing engineering standards and a small-PR discipline.
  • Authored org-wide strategy documents (Whitepages as a Platform, Single Source of Data Definitions, Data Release Tenets) shaping platform architecture and release governance.

Technology: Python, Rust, Scala, CUE, Nix, Kubernetes, Helm, Databricks, Delta Lake, MCP
